admission.justification: The dual-path design with a compatibility reader was the live alternative during review (old-path readers existed on the current line); the whole-file one-time move was chosen by developer ruling D109. It constrains every future settings reader to the same guard.

alternatives.option: Move the whole user settings file once to the standard user config location; every reader uses the same location guard; old-only and both-path states refuse.
alternatives.reason: One file ends ambiguity between project and user paths; the refusal states are explicit instead of silently merged.

alternatives.option: Keep dual project/user paths with a compatibility reader that merges or falls back.
alternatives.reason: Rejected: silent merging reintroduces the ambiguity D109 removed, and a fallback reader would need its own authority story.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The platform defines a new standard user config location that supersedes the current one.

consequences: No compatibility reader for the old path exists; old-only and both-path states refuse.
The upgrade command moves the whole JSON file once, preserves metadata, and refuses an existing destination.
context: Developer ruling D109 on leaf 260928-MIK-L71: the whole user settings file moves once to the standard user config location.
decider: developer (D109, carried by Owner semantic case 4ef8129e)
